# Calculating amount to withhold
The easiest way to work out how much tax to withhold is to use our online tax withheld calculator or the tax tables.

## Calculating PAYG withholding
The easiest and quickest way to work out how much tax to withhold is to use our online [tax withheld calculator](https://www.ato.gov.au/calculators-and-tools/tax-withheld-calculator).
